name: Water Mission
description: A Christian engineering nonprofit founded by George and Molly Greene that designs and builds safe-water systems for communities, refugee settlements, and disaster zones.
faithStatement: Water Mission serves as a Christian engineering ministry, bringing safe water as an expression of God's love.
work: Disaster response worldwide, including Nepal flooding in 2026

headlineStats.label: Years with Charity Navigator's top rating

featureStory.title: Project Living Water
featureStory.body: Water Mission's very first effort was called "Project Living Water," and the treatment unit it still builds today is named the Living Water Treatment System. Long before our bottles existed, the same two words were already bringing safe water to people.

tagline: Christian engineering nonprofit bringing safe water to the world.
about: Founded in 2001 by George and Molly Greene and based in North Charleston, South Carolina, Water Mission designs and builds safe-water, sanitation, and hygiene solutions for communities, refugee camps, and disaster zones.
keyFacts: Permanent programs in Honduras, Indonesia, Kenya, Malawi, Mexico, Peru, and Tanzania
Top Charity Navigator rating 19 years running

name: Water for Good
description: A Christian organization founded in the Central African Republic by Jim Hocking. In 2024 it merged with Lifewater International (established 1977) and continues under the Water for Good name.
faithStatement: Water for Good works alongside local churches so that whole villages can be healthy, in body and in spirit.
work: "Vision of a Healthy Village" three-year model

headlineStats.label: People with reliable water each year
Median drop in childhood diarrhea in completed villages

tagline: Lasting clean water, partnering with local churches.
about: Founded in 2004 in the Central African Republic and merged with Lifewater International in 2024, Water for Good works alongside local churches through its three-year "Vision of a Healthy Village" model.
keyFacts: Works in Cambodia, Central African Republic, Ethiopia, Uganda, and Tanzania
Reliable water for 1.3M+ people every year
90% of its water points stay working
Completed villages see a median 90% drop in childhood diarrhea

name: Convoy of Hope
description: A global faith-based organization serving people through wells, water filters, community facilities, and disaster relief.
faithStatement: Convoy of Hope is a faith-based organization driven to bring help and hope to those who are impoverished, hungry, and hurting.
work: Water filters in Ukraine and Indonesia
A community bathhouse in Sredets, Bulgaria
Bottled water for U.S. disaster relief
statsNote: Convoy of Hope has not yet published a water-only total. The figure shown covers all of its programs, not just water.
tagline: Faith-based relief bringing water where it's needed most.
about: Founded in 1994 and based in Springfield, Missouri, Convoy of Hope serves people around the world through relief, food, and community programs, including clean water.
keyFacts: Water filters in Ukraine and Indonesia
Bottled water for U.S. disaster relief
